name: rust-scan-unloadable-manifest-skip
body: Limit: a discovered Cargo manifest that yields no loadable package is skipped with a warning (the per-manifest error arm continues rather than aborting), and the separate-crate planned-node e2e fixture depends on that behavior: src/agentlib's package is discovered with src/lib.rs absent at main and must be skipped, not fail the scan, until the code lands. Upgrade if discovery ever fails closed on an unloadable manifest: the scan must then surface per-manifest errors and the fixture guard must revisit its assumption.
